message.reasoning_content: "That'll Be the Day" — recorded by Beatles (Quarrymen/ BBC, on Anthology 1 and Live at the BBC). Lead vocal by John (BBC version) and Quarrymen version had... The Anthology 1 version: John sings lead, with harmonies. Only John? Yes, John sings lead solo. So yes.
